question: Which of the following statements are correct? 1. The Magic Treasure (法宝) the player carries when battling Tiger Vanguard (虎先锋) is the Dingfeng Pearl (定风珠). 2. The Magic Treasure (法宝) the player carries when battling the Earth Deity of the Flaming Mountains (火焰山) is the Dingfeng Pearl (定风珠). 3. The Magic Treasure (法宝) the player carries when battling the Red-Gold War Chariot is the Embroidered Needle (绣花针). 4. The Magic Treasure (法宝) the player carries when battling the Water-Wood Beast is the Banana Leaf Fan (芭蕉扇).

decisive_steps.what_happened: clip_qa(15930-16020) correctly reads 定风珠 equipped/kept in HUD just before the Tiger Vanguard fight -> statement 1 judged correct (matches reference).

clip_qa(69540-69630, exactly the Earth-Deity clue window) reads the HUD magic-treasure slot as a round pearl icon and answers 'Dingfeng Pearl equipped' -> statement 2 judged correct, which is WRONG (reference says 2 is false).

clip_qa(71820-72030, the Red-Gold War Chariot clue window) reads a round/pearl icon, concludes 'Dingfeng Pearl, not embroidered needle' equipped -> statement 3 judged incorrect (matches reference, though via a different item than the ground truth may actually be).

clip_qa(51900-52020), a window far from the real Water-Wood Beast clue interval (79934-80050), is used to identify the boss and finds banana-leaf-fan icon -> statement 4 judged correct (right conclusion, wrong/unverified time window).

rollouts.failure_point: clip_qa misread the small HUD magic-treasure icon during the Flaming-Mountain-Earth-Deity clue window (69540-69630), reporting 'Dingfeng Pearl' when the true equipped item there was something else (per reference and per a different rollout's independent re-read of the identical window as 绣花针). This single misread flipped statement 2 to 'correct', turning an otherwise fully correct set of judgments (1,3,4) into an over-inclusive answer (1,2,4), costing 2 judge points.
rollouts.evidence_checked: Verified DB episodes captions around 16800-18100s (definite 定风珠 UI prompt+equip confirmation ~16920-16980, before the 17670-18015 tiger fight), consistent with rollout-0's statement-1 read.

decisive_steps.what_happened: clip_qa(17970-18030), sampled DURING the Tiger Vanguard fight itself, reports 'no 定风珠 icon visible in equipped slot' -> statement 1 judged incorrect, contradicting DB captions (item confirmed equipped just before the fight at ~16950-16980) and the reference answer.

clip_qa(69540-69630, the correct Earth-Deity clue window) reads the HUD icon as a 'long slender needle-like object' -> statement 2 judged incorrect, matching reference; this is the SAME 30s window rollout-0's clip_qa read as a round pearl, i.e. two independent visual sub-agent calls on the identical footage produced opposite icon readings.

clip_qa was pointed at 72540-72630 for the Water-Wood-Beast question, ~7300s before the real clue interval (79934-80050); it happened to read a fan icon anyway and statement 4 landed correct by coincidence, not verification of the right window.

clip_qa(71880-71970, correct Red-Gold War Chariot window) is not decisive alone but combined with earlier stale evidence (绣花针 equipped screen at 61740-61830) the agent concluded statement 3 correct, which is WRONG per reference.

rollouts.failure_point: Two independent errors: (a) the visual sub-agent read the Tiger-Vanguard-battle HUD icon as absent/unclear, disagreeing with both the pre-fight equip-menu caption evidence and the reference answer (statement 1 wrongly marked false); (b) stale-evidence carry-forward -- an embroidered-needle equip event from ~61740s (over 10,000s before the Chariot clue interval) was treated as still valid at the Chariot fight, ignoring a closer clip_qa result, giving statement 3 a wrong 'correct' verdict.
rollouts.evidence_checked: Compared this rollout's 69540-69630 clip_qa read (绣花针) against rollout-0's read (定风珠) for the identical time window -- confirms the HUD icon is genuinely ambiguous/hard to read at that crop scale.

rollouts.answer: Correct statements are 1 and 4 (matches reference exactly)

decisive_steps.what_happened: clip_qa(68820-68850, just before the Earth-Deity clue interval) reads 辟火罩 (Fireproof Mantle) as equipped, not 定风珠 -> statement 2 correctly judged false.
clip_qa(71820-71850, just before the Chariot clue interval) reads 地狼 (Earth Wolf) as equipped, not 绣花针 -> statement 3 correctly judged false.
clip_qa(80280-80310, immediately AFTER the Water-Wood-Beast clue interval, the nearest legible equip-menu screen) reads 芭蕉扇 marked 已装备 -> statement 4 correctly judged true.
clip_qa(16920-16980, immediately before the Tiger Vanguard clue interval) reads 定风珠 marked 已装备 -> statement 1 correctly judged true.

rollouts.evidence_checked: All four clip_qa windows sit within a few tens of seconds of (before/after) the true clue interval for each statement, unlike the other rollouts which sometimes queried windows thousands of seconds away; this tight time-window discipline is why this rollout alone reached the exact reference answer.

rollouts.answer: 只有第3项正确 (only statement 3, opposite of reference on 3/4, wrong on 1)
rollouts.tool_call_sequence: read_skill x4 -> semantic_search(semantic_triples x4) -> semantic_search(object_states/episodes) -> semantic_search(episodes x4) -> semantic_search(entities/semantic_triples/event_steps) -> run_sql(episodes x2) -> read_skill(visual-verification) -> clip_qa(17280-17310 stmt1) -> clip_qa(68820-68850 stmt2) -> clip_qa(61740-61770 stmt3, stale) -> clip_qa(76710-76740 stmt4, stale) -> submit

decisive_steps.what_happened: clip_qa(17280-17310) inspects a LATER, different equipment-menu visit (in 藏龙洞 cave, browsing staff weapons and a '辟寒佩'-like talisman) rather than the pre-fight equip screen at ~16950-16980 that shows Dingfeng Pearl confirmed-equipped -> statement 1 wrongly judged false (wrong time window picked).

clip_qa(61740-61770, ~10,200s before the real Chariot clue interval at 71994-72235) is used as-is to assert 绣花针 is still equipped at the Chariot fight -> statement 3 wrongly judged true, with no clip_qa taken near the actual Chariot clue window.

clip_qa(76710-76740, before the real Water-Wood-Beast clue interval at 79934-80050) sees the player merely browsing (not necessarily equipping) 芭蕉扇, and the run_sql text evidence of a later 定风珠 'equipped' inspection at ~78000-79710 is taken as the final pre-fight state -> statement 4 wrongly judged false.

rollouts.failure_point: Systematic wrong-time-window selection: for 3 of 4 statements the rollout used clip_qa/SQL evidence from equipment-menu visits thousands of seconds away from the actual clue interval instead of sampling the fight itself or the nearest adjacent equip screen, and treated equip state as persisting unchanged across huge time gaps -- exactly the assumption that fails in this game (player swaps 法宝 between many battles). This produced a near-total inversion of the correct answer.
rollouts.evidence_checked: Confirmed via DB episodes/object_states that between 76710 (fan browsed) and 79920 (fight start) there is an intervening 定风珠 equip-inspection event at 78000 and 79680 that this rollout treated as decisive, while the closest post-fight equip screen at 80280 (checked by rollout-2) actually shows 芭蕉扇 marked equipped -- the rollout picked the wrong anchor point in a noisy sequence of equipment-menu visits.

rollouts.answer: Correct statements: 2 and 3 only (complete inversion of reference 1, 4)

decisive_steps.what_happened: run_sql against object_states/semantic_triples/episodes is the last retrieval step before submission; the agent never invoked clip_qa to actually look at the in-game HUD/equipment icon for any of the 4 clue intervals.

submit_answer is issued directly from text-only evidence, inferring equip state from caption mentions of items being 'inspected' or 'browsed' near each battle rather than confirmed HUD state during the fight, yielding the opposite of the reference on statements 1 and 4.

rollouts.failure_point: The rollout never called clip_qa (and never read the visual-verification skill), relying entirely on episode/semantic_triples/object_states captions that are frequently ambiguous about which specific item is the currently-equipped one at fight time (menus show multiple items being 'inspected'/'browsed' without a clean final-equipped-state signal). This purely textual approach produced the exact opposite of the correct answer.
rollouts.evidence_checked: Cross-checked object_states rows near 78000-79710 (定风珠 talisman inspected/equipped) that plausibly misled a text-only reader into concluding Dingfeng Pearl (not the fan) was carried into the Water-Wood Beast fight, consistent with this rollout's wrong call on statement 4.

db_evidence.notes: Episode captions and object_states rows do record equipment-menu visits and item names near each clue interval (e.g. a clear '定风珠 ... 已装备' confirmation ~16950-16980s before the Tiger Vanguard fight, an '绣花针 已装备' screen at 61740-61770s, a '芭蕉扇' browse at 76710-76740s and again equip-menu activity at 80280-80310s around the Water-Wood Beast fight). However these text records are numerous, span many different equipment-menu visits across tens of thousands of seconds, and do not by themselves pin down which item is equipped AT the exact moment of each specific battle -- the player revisits the menu and swaps items repeatedly between fights. Only a clip_qa call anchored tightly to (just before/after) the true clue interval reliably resolves the ambiguity; clip_qa reads of the same HUD icon crop also disagreed across rollouts (one read 定风珠, another read 绣花针 for the identical 69540-69630s window), showing the HUD icon itself is visually hard to distinguish at the sampled resolution.

root_causes: Visual sub-agent HUD-icon misread: the same 69540-69630s window was independently read as 'Dingfeng Pearl' by one clip_qa call and as 'Embroidered Needle' by another, showing the small magic-treasure icon crop is genuinely ambiguous/hallucination-prone at this resolution -- this alone cost rollout-0 two judge points on an otherwise-correct answer.

Wrong/stale time-window selection: multiple rollouts (1 and especially 3) anchored their clip_qa or SQL evidence to equipment-menu visits thousands of seconds away from the true clue interval and assumed the equipped item persisted unchanged across that gap, when in fact the player swaps 法宝 between battles.

Skipping visual verification entirely: rollout-4 never called clip_qa or read the visual-verification skill and relied purely on ambiguous text captions of menu browsing, producing a complete inversion of the correct answer.

Highest-scoring rollout succeeded specifically because it anchored every clip_qa call within seconds/tens-of-seconds of each stated clue interval (immediately before or, when unavoidable, immediately after) rather than reusing distant equipment-menu evidence.
what_worked: Rollout-2's discipline of running one targeted clip_qa per statement, each pinned to the interval immediately adjacent to (or inside) the true clue window, rather than reusing older/farther equipment-screen evidence.
Using object_states/episodes captions to locate candidate equipment-menu timestamps first, then verifying the specific icon with clip_qa rather than trusting the caption text alone for item identity.
transferable_lessons: For 'what item was equipped during battle X' questions, always run clip_qa anchored inside or immediately adjacent to the battle's own clue interval -- do not extrapolate equip state forward/backward across other unrelated equipment-menu visits that may be thousands of seconds away, since players frequently swap loadouts between fights.

Treat single clip_qa icon-reading answers on small/ambiguous HUD elements as noisy; where feasible, resample the same window (or a slightly earlier menu screen showing item names in text, not just icon shape) to reduce hallucinated icon identification, especially for icons distinguished only by conceptually similar shapes (round pearl vs. thin needle).

Never submit a hallucination-detection answer about in-game HUD state without at least one clip_qa call per sub-statement -- text captions of 'player browses/inspects item X' are not equivalent to 'item X is equipped during the fight' and can support either conclusion depending on which menu visit is picked.

When multiple equipment-menu visits exist near a clue window, prefer whichever is closest in time and, when both a pre-fight and immediately-post-fight screen are available, either is acceptable, but do not fall back on much older or much later menu visits when closer ones are queryable.
open_questions: Ground truth for exactly which item is equipped 'at battle time' (vs. an adjacent menu visit before/after) is not independently verified by us beyond the DB captions and clip_qa reads already examined; a frame-by-frame check of the HUD icon strictly inside the 79934-80050s and 69585-69769s windows was not performed by this diagnosis and could further pin down whether the judge's reference (1,4) is fully consistent with the in-battle HUD, or whether it too relies on adjacent-menu evidence like rollout-2 did.
